# EnjoyAlgorithms

> > Industry-focused computer science learning platform offering self-paced and live courses in DSA, machine learning, system design, and OOPS with interview preparation focus.

EnjoyAlgorithms is a comprehensive CS education platform designed for coding interview preparation and professional development. The platform combines self-paced courses, live mentored classes, and curated blog tutorials covering data structures, algorithms, machine learning, system design, and object-oriented programming.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Machine Learning
- System Design
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS)
- Interview Preparation
- Coding Interview Prep
- Design Patterns
- Deep Learning
- Python
- Live Classes
- Self-Paced Learning
- Data Science
- Distributed Systems
- Neural Networks
- Java

## Core Platform

- [EnjoyAlgorithms Homepage](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com): Main landing page for the industry-focused CS learning platform
- [All Courses](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/courses): Complete course catalog including DSA, ML, system design, and OOPS offerings
- [Reviews & Testimonials](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/reviews-and-testimonials): Customer testimonials and reviews of EnjoyAlgorithms courses
- [Success Stories](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/stories): Success stories of tech professionals who used EnjoyAlgorithms

## Data Structures & Algorithms Courses

- [DSA Interview Courses](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/data-structures-and-algorithms-course): Self-paced DSA course for coding interview preparation
- [16-Week Live DSA Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/dsa-course-for-beginners-and-intermediate-learners): 16-week live DSA course with mentorship for beginners and intermediate learners
- [10-Week Live DSA Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/dsa-course-for-advanced-learners): 10-week live DSA course for advanced learners and interview prep
- [Coding Interview Blogs](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/coding-interview): DSA blogs and tutorials for coding interview preparation

## Machine Learning & Data Science Courses

- [Machine Learning Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/machine-learning-courses): Project-based ML course with Python and interview prep focus
- [16-Week Live ML Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/live-machine-learning-course): 16-week live ML course for beginners and intermediate learners
- [Machine Learning Blogs](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/machine-learning): ML and data science tutorials covering neural networks and deep learning

## System Design & OOPS Courses

- [System Design Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/system-design-courses): Self-paced system design course for interview preparation
- [System Design Blogs](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/system-design): System design tutorials covering caching and distributed systems
- [OOPS Design Course](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/oops-course): Self-paced OOPS course with design patterns and principles
- [OOPS Concept Blogs](https://www.enjoyalgorithms.com/oops-concepts): OOP concepts and design patterns tutorials for Java programming
